label: Teltonika TRB143
description: A gigabit 4G gateway with M-Bus: one 10/100/1000 Ethernet port, a Micro-USB and M-Bus support for reading utility meters. The one Teltonika gateway with a gigabit port and a meter bus.
notes: Vendor figures from the TRB143 datasheet: 1 x ETH port 10/100/1000 Mbps (IEEE 802.3); M-Bus support; Micro-USB; 4G LTE Cat 4. No Wi-Fi. M-Bus is a metering bus, not an Ethernet interface, so it is described here rather than modelled as a port.

label: Teltonika TRB160
description: A gigabit 4G Cat 6 gateway in a small industrial case: one RJ45 at 10/100/1000, USB Type-C, no switch and no radio.
notes: Vendor figures from the TRB160 datasheet: 1 x RJ45 port 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet; USB Type-C; 4G LTE Cat 6, modelled at the 300 Mbps downlink class. No Wi-Fi.

label: Teltonika TRB246
description: An industrial IoT gateway: one 10/100 Ethernet port, a connector block carrying digital and analog I/O plus RS232 and RS485, and a 4G Cat 4 modem.
notes: Vendor figures from the TRB246 datasheet: 1 x ETH port 10/100 Mbps (IEEE 802.3); a connector block with I/O pins and RS232/RS485; 4G LTE Cat 4. Serial pins are modelled as console interfaces, as elsewhere in the Teltonika range.

label: Teltonika TRB256
description: An NB-IoT and LTE Cat M1 gateway: one 10/100 Ethernet port, I/O and serial pins, and a low-power wide-area modem rather than a broadband one.
notes: Vendor figures from the TRB256 datasheet: 1 x ETH port 10/100 Mbps (IEEE 802.3); a connector block with I/O and RS232/RS485; LTE Cat M1 / NB-IoT. The cellular interface is modelled at 1M because Cat M1 tops out around 1 Mbps - two orders of magnitude below the Cat 4 units, and the reason this device exists is that it does not need more.

label: Teltonika RUTM10
description: A wired industrial router with no modem and no radio: 1 WAN + 3 LAN, all gigabit. For a cabinet that already has an uplink and needs routing, VLANs and a firewall rather than another radio.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUTM10 datasheet: 1 x WAN port 10/100/1000 Mbps and 3 x LAN ports 10/100/1000 Mbps, IEEE 802.3 with auto MDI/MDIX. No cellular modem and no Wi-Fi on this model.

label: Teltonika RUT361
description: A compact industrial cellular router: 1 WAN + 1 LAN at 10/100 and a 4G Cat 4 modem in a DIN-rail case.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUT361 datasheet: 1 x WAN Ethernet port and 1 x LAN port at 10/100 Mbps (IEEE 802.3/802.3u); 4G LTE Cat 4. No Wi-Fi is claimed here because the datasheet section confirming a radio was not captured during intake - if the unit does have one, it is a gap in this spec and worth a comment on the request.
